name: Quote-volume bar pullback
hypothesis: Buy a higher-low break on completed quote-volume bars while longer-window flow remains positive.
spec: Setup: Equal economic-volume bars may reduce distortion from variable activity. Entry: Buy a higher-low break on completed quote-volume bars while longer-window flow remains positive. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the higher low or on net-flow reversal. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
